title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 7.21
exact_target: Can one choose unit complex numbers so that the limiting sizes of all their power sums grow sublinearly in the exponent?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2307021 (AMR-022-7021). CC BY4.0.
